title: Approximate expansion matching does not transfer external cosmological fits
assumptions: The source shows chosen curves for homogeneous H(z) only; external likelihoods, data and priors are not evaluated in this EFT.
The Naidoo comparison assigns a daughter EOS and constant Lambda rather than deriving those functions from the displayed quintessence EFT.
predictions: Background overlap alone leaves perturbation, growth, CMB/ISW, fifth-force and likelihood/parameter-prior differences undetermined.
The source inference that detailed fits need not be repeated is unsupported for the full model; external fit results retain their original model conditioning.
A narrower controlled comparison can establish similarity of selected distance integrals only, after common normalization and inputs are fixed.
status_reason: The methodological distinction is supported; the transferred-fit claim is unsupported. Status clarified with the reviewing Sol agent.
